verdict.rationale: DLG's own pages list O-1, H-1B, TN, E-3, L-1 and EB-1 green cards. Its 'visa options for entrepreneurs' blog covers E-2 investment, a B-1-in-contemplation-of-E-2 route, and a worked O-1 founder scenario, which gives some guidance on choosing. H-1B appears only as a service listing, and the green-card coverage is limited to EB-1. missing for 10: cap-exempt H-1B routes, other founder green-card paths (e.g. EB-2 NIW, EB-5), structured side-by-side guidance on choosing between options, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider's own materials cover the full startup visa menu — O-1, H-1B (including cap-exempt routes), E-2, TN, and the green-card paths — with guidance on choosing the right one for my situation
